summary: Defines an architecture for SIP peering, including its functional parts and interfaces. It also walks through the steps needed to set up a session between two SIP service provider domains. This informational document is part of the SPEERMINT working group's output.

eli5.summary: Imagine two phone companies who want their customers to call each other over the internet. This document draws the blueprint for the pieces they need and the steps to make a call work.
